- $\frac{14}{8} = \frac{7}{4}$

Now multiply all the simplified terms:

$$
2 \cdot \frac{8}{3} \cdot \frac{7}{4} = \frac{2 \cdot 8 \cdot 7}{3 \cdot 4} = \frac{112}{12} = \frac{28}{3}
$$",
